context: AMENDED 2026-10-24 from an independent review of the PR-checks versus Trunk split: this is the largest CI saving available. SELECTION_SHADOW forces escalate=True (scripts/coverage_test_selection.py:814-829), so every PR runs the full medium tier and correctness gate (31 of 40 sampled CI runs), and the medium tier runs up to three times per merge (PR, Trunk, Trunk coverage). Estimated saving up to about 50 runner-hours a day on the PR side (estimate, about +/-30%). Waits on trunk-red-run-triage-20261024 for the baseline classification (selection misses surface as Trunk failures and the 12.7% red rate would hide them), not on the later rate target, and on the CI usage report for measurement. The repository is public, so GitHub-hosted runner minutes are free; the binding limit is the concurrency cap. Queue time and PR time-to-green are the primary success metrics, runner-minutes secondary. Priority raised to high.
description: Set SELECTION_SHADOW=False in scripts/coverage_test_selection.py only when the heavy-tier routing fix, the inert-path manifest and map v2 are merged and at least 20 code-routed PRs show zero shadow misses. Record the measured would-select rate, escalation rate and runner-minutes saved in the PR; if savings are negligible, propose retiring selection instead. The 20-PR window restarts whenever map freshness changes (for example when Trunk coverage moves to a schedule). Closing needs a 14-day observation window after going live, so this item stays open after its PR merges.
